patch_description: Add targeted observation goals when remembered objectives are disconnected or progress toward a reachable objective stalls. A separate optimistic search identifies stale walls and diagonal clearance cells that could reconnect a route, while preserving the door’s interaction state. The agent then approaches a reachable viewpoint using its existing learned hazard planner. Observation goals expire or terminate when their blocking cells are refreshed; optimistic passages never become executable movement edges. This targets route-recovery failures without changing the dynamics learner or its interventions. Performance remains to be evaluated.
